summary: Iteration 53 — Notification Workflow Testing (Backend Only). 133/133 tests PASS (100%). All 17 new notification tests pass (test_notifications_iter53.py): booking_accepted/refused/cancelled, payment_authorized/captured/failed/refunded (full+partial), subscription_activated/cancelling/cancelled/renewed/payment_failed, anti-doublon idempotence (webhook + booking). All 3 regression suites pass: test_webhooks_iter52 (28/28), test_stripe_payment_iter50 (61/61), test_subscriptions_iter51 (27/27). One test infrastructure fix applied: added pythonpath=. to pytest.ini to allow direct module imports from /app/backend.

minor.issue: TEST INFRA FIX: tests/test_subscriptions_iter51.py tests 21-23 failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pricing_engine'. Root cause: pytest did not add /app/backend to sys.path automatically. Fix: added 'pythonpath = .' to /app/backend/pytest.ini. Now 27/27 pass.

action_items: PROD: Set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET to a real value before going to production (currently empty — no HMAC verification in test env)
PROD: Populate subscription_plans table with real plans before production launch
critical_code_review_comments: webhook_handlers.py: Notification architecture is correct and complete. All 12 events covered with no duplicates. Anti-doublon guard (rows_updated > 0) prevents phantom notifications on idempotent transitions. Notifications sent AFTER pool connection released — no deadlock risk.

booking_routes.py: _push() uses asyncio.create_task (fire-and-forget) for send_push_to_user which itself calls store_notification(). This means the notification is async but reliable since store_notification() uses its own pool.acquire(). The 1s sleep in tests is sufficient to catch the async write.
push_service.py: store_notification() correctly uses the notifications table with type/title/body/data/read columns. WebSocket broadcast included for real-time delivery.
pytest.ini: Added pythonpath=. to ensure backend modules are importable from tests/ subdirectory. This is a test infrastructure fix — no production code changed.

mocked_apis.stripe_signature_verification: MOCKED — STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty, no HMAC verification in test env
mocked_apis.expo_push_notifications: MOCKED/SKIPPED — no active push tokens in test DB, send_push_notification never called, but store_notification() IS called and persisted in DB

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Used existing user_demo001 (user), user_coach001 (coach), svc_demo001, plan_premium. Each test creates and cleans up its own ephemeral rows (payments, bookings, subscriptions, stripe_webhook_events, notifications).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 53 complete. All 133 tests pass. Key facts: (1) test_notifications_iter53.py: 17 new tests covering all 12 notification events + anti-doublon; (2) pytest.ini now has pythonpath=. — required for modules like pricing_engine to be importable from tests/ directory; (3) Notification system uses push_service.store_notification() → INSERT into notifications table + WebSocket broadcast; (4) booking_routes._push() is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task — tests use asyncio.sleep(1) before checking DB; (5) Webhook notifications sent AFTER pool connection released in dispatch() — correct architecture to avoid deadlocks; (6) subscription_plans table has plan_premium (active=True) — no need to create temp plan like in iter52.

rca_of_issue.bug: 3 tests in test_subscriptions_iter51.py failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pricing_engine'
rca_of_issue.root_cause: pytest.ini lacked pythonpath configuration. When running pytest from /app/backend, the /app/backend directory was not added to sys.path automatically, so direct imports like 'from pricing_engine import pricing_engine' failed.
